title: Wildly Spicy Charred Beef Noodle Stir Fry
description: A spicy and savory stir-fry with charred beef, noodles, and vietnamese flavors, perfect for a keto diet.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
2. Add the charred beef to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until browned.
3. Add the garlic and ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
4. Add the noodles to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
5. Add the red pepper flakes, fish sauce, and soy sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
6. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
7. Serve the charred beef and noodle stir-fry hot, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
